talks.speaker: D. Todd Christofferson

talks.summary: Presented Church leaders for members to sustain.

talks.speaker: Tamara W. Runia

talks.summary: Reminds listeners that God knows their individual experiences and has a plan for them.

talks.title: The Gift of Testimony
talks.summary: Describes testimony of Jesus Christ as a gift of the Spirit and encourages us to share it.

talks.speaker: Vaiangina Sikahema
talks.title: Prophets, Seers, and Revelators
talks.summary: Encourages listening to and following the counsel of prophets and apostles.

talks.speaker: Kevin J. Hathaway
talks.title: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
talks.summary: Teaches that turning to Jesus Christ can bring deliverance amid affliction.

talks.speaker: Ulisses Soares
talks.title: A Higher and Holier Fast
talks.summary: Presents fasting as worship that refines discipleship and draws us closer to the Lord.

talks.speaker: Sean Douglas
talks.title: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
talks.summary: Invites the rising generation to consider prophetic counsel about missionary service.

talks.speaker: D. Todd Christofferson

talks.speaker: Dale G. Renlund

talks.speaker: Hutch U. Fale
talks.title: I Am a Child of God

talks.speaker: Patrick Kearon

talks.speaker: Rosemary K. Chibota

talks.speaker: Neil L. Andersen
talks.title: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ

talks.speaker: James G. O. Fantone

talks.speaker: Edward Dube

talks.speaker: Quentin L. Cook

talks.speaker: Alfred Kyungu

talks.speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
talks.title: Christ-Centered Unity

talks.speaker: Andrea Muñoz Spannaus

talks.speaker: Gary E. Stevenson

talks.speaker: Gabriel W. Reid
talks.title: You Are Good Enough to Teach
talks.summary: Places love for the Lord and for learners at the center of gospel teaching.

talks.speaker: Clark G. Gilbert
talks.title: Teach Truth with Love

talks.speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
talks.title: Closing Remarks
